reviews.author: Ramoju. Venkat
reviews.text:
I am extremely grateful to Dr. Vamsi Krishna for the excellent treatment I received after my left tibia fracture. He performed the intramedullary nailing surgery with great precision, and the entire process was handled very smoothly.

From the first consultation to the follow-up visits, Dr. Vamsi Krishna explained everything clearly, answered all my questions patiently, and gave me the confidence I needed during recovery. His professional expertise, combined with his caring approach, made a huge difference in my healing journey.

Thanks to his guidance and support, I am now walking comfortably and steadily regaining my strength. I would highly recommend Dr. Vamsi Krishna to anyone looking for an experienced and compassionate orthopedic doctor.
